expenses.description: Organic NPK Fertilizer and Urea bags
Tractor rental for plowing and tilling
Daily wages for sowing and crop alignment

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.description: An initiative by the Government of India providing up to ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments as minimum income support to small and marginal farmers.
schemes.eligibility: All small and landholder farmer families having cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares.

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
schemes.description: Financial assistance for purchase of agricultural machinery, tractors, power tillers, and custom hiring centers to reduce physical labor cost.
schemes.eligibility: Registered farmers with land details. Special preference to SC, ST, and Women farmers.

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Government-sponsored crop insurance scheme that integrates multiple stakeholders to cover yield losses from natural calamities, pests, and local risks.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.

schemes.name: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
schemes.description: Aims at making agriculture more productive, sustainable, and climate resilient through micro-irrigation systems, organic soil health cards, and rainfed technologies.
schemes.eligibility: All categories of farmers, with focus on sustainable soil health management.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme (SHC)
schemes.description: Provides farmers with Soil Health Cards showing nutrient status of their soil along with customized fertilizer recommendations to optimize crop yield and soil quality.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers holding agricultural land holdings in India.

schemes.name: PMKSY (Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana)
schemes.description: Aims to achieve convergence of investments in irrigation at the field level, expand cultivable area under assured irrigation, and improve on-farm water use efficiency.
schemes.eligibility: All categories of landholders, agricultural cooperatives, and farmer self-help groups.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.description: Provides farmers with easy access to short-term, low-interest agricultural credit for purchasing seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and other farming necessities.
schemes.eligibility: All individual or joint land-holding farmers, tenant farmers, and sharecroppers.

notifications.title: Heavy Rainfall Warning
notifications.message: IMD forecasts heavy rain (>50mm) starting in 24 hours. Postpone any fertilizer spraying to avoid runoffs.

notifications.title: Low Soil Moisture Alert
notifications.message: Field Sector B-4 moisture has dropped to 18%. Automatic drip irrigation has been recommended.

notifications.title: Pest Activity Spotted Nearby
notifications.message: Farmers in adjacent blocks reported Armyworm sightings. Inspect paddy leaves for bite marks immediately.
